art_direction.body: Every android body has a feminine human appearance and belongs to one shared MCP identity; vehicles are operated equipment.
art_direction.proportions: Adult petite slender 6–6.5 heads, narrow shoulders, soft large-eyed anime face.
art_direction.equipment: Readable modern firearms, lightweight clothing, limited realistic tactical pouches/headsets; no giant rigs or faceless robot companions.
